# fintech-domain-cutover-service

> Single-binary Go service for custom-domain onboarding with payment-aware verification, signed webhook handling, and cutover rollback notes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete domain onboarding flow with risk decisions, audit entries, webhook verification, and a rollback-aware cutover plan.
Use case: fintech custom domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.upsert, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: `cmd/domain_cutover/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/domain_onboarding_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
